property.name: panelColor
property.label: Panel Background Colour (hex)
property.description: Hex colour code for the panel background, e.g. #4CAF50

property.name: textColor
property.label: Text Colour (hex)
property.description: Hex colour code for the panel text, e.g. #ffffff

property.name: iconName
property.label: Icon Name (SLDS)
property.description: SLDS icon name to display on the left, e.g. standard:account or utility:info. Leave empty to hide the icon.

property.name: textLine1
property.label: Text – Line 1
property.description: Bold primary text. Embed live record field values using {{FieldApiName}} tokens, e.g. 'SLA Breached · {{SLA_Remaining__c}} overdue' or '{{Name}}'. Any valid field API name on the current object is supported.

property.name: textLine2
property.label: Text – Line 2
property.description: Lighter secondary text. Supports the same {{FieldApiName}} merge syntax as Text Line 1, e.g. 'Owner: {{Owner.Name}} · Priority: {{Priority}}'.

property.name: textAlignment
property.label: Text Alignment
property.description: Alignment of the text: left, center, or right.

property.name: button1Label
property.label: Button 1 – Label
property.description: Label for the first button. Supports custom labels ({!$Label.c.MyLabel}). Leave empty to hide the button.

property.name: button1Variant
property.label: Button 1 – Variant
property.description: SLDS button variant: bare, neutral, brand, brand-outline, inverse, destructive, destructive-text, success.

property.name: button1Flow
property.label: Button 1 – Autolaunched Flow API Name
property.description: API name of an autolaunched flow to invoke when Button 1 is clicked. The flow will receive the current record Id as input parameter 'recordId'.

property.name: button2Label
property.label: Button 2 – Label
property.description: Label for the second button. Supports custom labels ({!$Label.c.MyLabel}). Leave empty to hide the button.

property.name: button2Variant
property.label: Button 2 – Variant
property.description: SLDS button variant: bare, neutral, brand, brand-outline, inverse, destructive, destructive-text, success.

property.name: button2Flow
property.label: Button 2 – Autolaunched Flow API Name
property.description: API name of an autolaunched flow to invoke when Button 2 is clicked. The flow will receive the current record Id as input parameter 'recordId'.

property.name: recordId
property.label: Record Id
property.description: Id of the record to pass into triggered autolaunched flows.
